# To the Stars 💫

In the silent depths of space, the Space Patrol calls to those who feel the pull of the unknown. It’s an invitation for explorers seeking new horizons and the mysteries hidden among the stars!

Captain Aryana H. awaits those ready to journey into the unknown. Join her crew, and let the next star mark the beginning of your story 🚀
